leadText: (Japanese: ～序章～メガガブリアスの物語 ~Prologue~ The Story of Mega ) is the first bonus chapter of the Pocket Monsters XY: The Legend of the Pokémon Dragon King manga. It first appeared as a sneak preview in the November 2013 issue of CoroCoro Comics magazine and later appeared in the collected volume release as a bonus chapter.
